d:
Welcome to Puglia, Italy! In this full-length travel vlog, we explore two of the most stunning coastal towns in Southern Italy — Monopoli and Polignano a Mare.
From charming old streets and whitewashed houses to breathtaking sea views and local food, this video takes you on an authentic Italian adventure through the heart of Puglia.
Destinations:
• Monopoli Old Town
• Polignano a Mare viewpoints
• Local Puglian cuisine and shopping centre
Watch till the end for travel tips, best photo spots, and what makes Puglia one of Italy’s most underrated regions!
